story.iWant: comprehensive OpenAPI documentation and audit logging for all customer APIs
story.soThat: I know how to call the APIs and compliance has a record of all operations
story.tasks: - Task 1: Configure SpringDoc-OpenAPI dependency and Swagger UI (AC: #1, #2) - Task 2: Add OpenAPI annotations to customer endpoints (AC: #3) - Task 3: Create OpenAPI schema definitions for request/response DTOs (AC: #3) - Task 4: Create AuditLog entity and repository (AC: #5, #6) - Task 5: Implement comprehensive audit logging for all operations (AC: #4) - Task 6: Create audit query API for compliance (AC: #8) - Task 7: Test Swagger UI and audit logging (AC: #1-8)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. OpenAPI 3.0 specification generated via SpringDoc-OpenAPI 2. Swagger UI available at /api/docs 3. Documentation includes: endpoints, request/response schemas, status codes, required headers, examples, required roles 4. Audit logging for all operations: CREATE (all attributes, user, timestamp), READ (access log), UPDATE (before/after values), DELETE (deletion reason) 5. Audit entries in PostgreSQL AUDIT_LOG table: auditId, timestamp, userId (JWT), operation (CREATE/READ/UPDATE/DELETE), entityType (CUSTOMER), entityId, changes (JSON), ipAddress, userAgent 6. Audit entries immutable (insert only, no update/delete) 7. Audit entries not in normal API responses 8. Audit query API: GET /api/v1/audit?entity=CUSTOMER&limit=100 (admin/compliance only)

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR013: Audit logging for all data mutations (who, what, when, why, before/after values). Comprehensive audit trail for compliance and regulatory requirements.

doc.title: Story 2.2: Customer Create API
doc.snippet: Story 2.2 established basic AuditService for CREATE operations. Story 2.8 extends it with comprehensive audit logging for all CRUD operations, AuditLog entity, and audit query API.

artifact.reason: Extend existing AuditService with comprehensive audit entry creation including changes JSON, ipAddress, userAgent extraction.
Add OpenAPI annotations (@Operation, @ApiResponse, @Parameter, @SecurityRequirement) to all customer endpoints (POST, GET, PUT, DELETE).

story-context.constraints: - OpenAPI 3.0 specification auto-generated - Swagger UI at /api/docs (configurable path) - Security scheme: BearerAuth (JWT from Zitadel) - All endpoints documented with examples - Audit entries immutable: No UPDATE or DELETE operations allowed - Audit query API restricted to ADMIN/COMPLIANCE_OFFICER roles - Changes field stores JSON: {fieldName: {before: value, after: value}} - ipAddress and userAgent extracted from HttpServletRequest - userId extracted from JWT SecurityContext - Story 2.2-2.6 must be completed (all CRUD operations exist)

tests.standards: Testing standards require Swagger UI accessibility tests, OpenAPI spec validation, comprehensive audit logging tests for all CRUD operations, and audit query API tests with role-based access.
tests.ideas: AC1: Test OpenAPI 3.0 spec generated at /v3/api-docs AC2: Test Swagger UI accessible at /api/docs AC3: Test all customer endpoints documented with correct schemas, status codes, examples, security requirements AC4: Test CREATE audit entry includes all customer attributes, user ID, timestamp AC4: Test READ audit entry logs customer access with user ID, timestamp AC4: Test UPDATE audit entry includes before/after values for changed fields only AC4: Test DELETE audit entry includes deletion reason, user ID, timestamp AC5: Test AuditLog entity persisted to AUDIT_LOG table with all fields: auditId, timestamp, userId, operation, entityType, entityId, changes (JSON), ipAddress, userAgent AC6: Test audit entries are immutable (no UPDATE or DELETE allowed) AC7: Test audit entries not returned in normal customer API responses AC8: Test audit query API accessible to ADMIN/COMPLIANCE_OFFICER roles only (403 for others) AC8: Test audit query API filters by entity type and supports pagination
